subject.title: feat(config): add separate base URLs for summary and embedding models

question: Should gitcrawl expose summary-specific endpoint configuration now, before a concrete summary command consumes it, or limit this PR to the currently exercised embedding endpoint?
rationale: Both choices are technically viable, but public TOML fields, environment variables, and CLI flags become long-lived compatibility surface and the repository does not yet establish the intended summary runtime boundary.

options.title: Land embedding controls only
options.body: Add the exercised embedding-specific endpoint now and defer summary endpoint controls until the summary command and provider boundary are implemented.

options.title: Commit to both endpoints
options.body: Accept both purpose-specific endpoint controls as the permanent public configuration contract and require live proof for each available runtime consumer.

options.title: Pause for summary design
options.body: Hold the PR until the summary command and its endpoint/provider ownership are designed together.

recommendation.title: Land embedding controls only
recommendation.body: Add the exercised embedding-specific endpoint now and defer summary endpoint controls until the summary command and provider boundary are implemented.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this contributor to the central CLI and configuration documentation surfaces affected by the contract decision.
